title: VAttnPO: Visual Attention-Guided Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.16735v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards commonly assigns one sequence advantage to an entire response. This outcome-level signal distinguishes overall response quality but leaves changes in visual-evidence use across generated tokens implicit. We introduce VAttnPO (Visual Attention-Guided Policy Optimization), which uses answer-conditioned visual attention to refine token-level credit while preserving the verifier-derived trajectory-mean advantage. A frozen old policy constructs a visual reference by teacher forcing the known correct answer and produces a visual distribution for each rollout token. VAttnPO measures their agreement in visual-attention space using Jensen--Shannon divergence, rather than reading guidance from teacher output-token distributions or introducing an attention-matching objective. translated_title: VAttnPO：视觉注意力引导的策略优化
translated_abstract: 具有可验证奖励的多模态强化学习通常将单一的序列优势分配给整个响应。这种结果层面的信号虽然能够区分整体响应质量的优劣，但使得生成词元之间视觉证据使用方式的变化保持隐式。我们提出VAttnPO（视觉注意力引导的策略优化），它利用答案条件下的视觉注意力来细化词元级别的信用分配，同时保留由验证器导出的轨迹平均优势。一个冻结的旧策略通过对已知正确答案进行教师强制来构建视觉参考，并为每个rollout词元生成一个视觉分布。VAttnPO使用Jensen-Shannon散度在视觉注意力空间中衡量二者的一致性，而不是从教师输出词元分布中读取指导信号，也不引入注意力匹配目标。轨迹中心化、相对位置加权和信用平衡将这种一致性转化为零均值的正向指导信号。
tldr: 提出VAttnPO方法，通过冻结旧策略的答案条件视觉注意力与当前策略rollout词元视觉分布之间的Jensen-Shannon散度一致性度量，在保留验证器轨迹平均优势的同时细化多模态强化学习中的词元级信用分配，从而显式改进视觉证据的使用。
en_tdlr: VAttnPO refines token-level credit assignment in multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards by measuring agreement in visual-attention space via Jensen-Shannon divergence against an answer-conditioned visual reference, explicitly improving the use of visual evidence while preserving the verifier-derived trajectory-mean advantage.
